create_identity_head: create an IdentityHead instance that returns input tensors unchanged for model output
use_identity_head_forward: use the IdentityHead forward method to pass input tensors through without modification
instantiate_from_config: instantiate an IdentityHead from a config dictionary containing a unique_id key
register_identity_head: register the IdentityHead class with the classy_vision head registry using the identity name
attach_identity_head_to_model: attach an IdentityHead to a model when the model output is already the desired result
